mmrSources.title: MMR sources
mmrSources.description: Local scraper with a built-in browser (no account, no API key, no ban risk).
mmrSources.enableLabel: Use the local scraper as the primary MMR provider

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.description1: The scraper browses rlstats.net in a hidden window, solves the Cloudflare challenge like a real browser, and extracts MMR for every playlist. It is cached for 30 minutes and queries once per player and match.
howItWorks.description2: RapidAPI and Parse.bot remain available as optional providers if you configure credentials; Tracker Network was disabled because it no longer issues API keys for Rocket League.

notes.title: Integration notes
notes.freePlan: Free plan detected: 5 player endpoints per day. Not enough for real live MMR use.
notes.proPlan: Pro plan detected: 1000 player endpoints per day and 10 req/s.
notes.priority: The app uses it before Tracker/RLStats, but still prioritizes local estimation for your own player.

parseBot.title: Parse.bot
parseBot.description: Configurable scraper with anti-bot bypass. Ideal when RLStats or Tracker are behind Cloudflare.
parseBot.enableLabel: Use Parse.bot as an MMR provider (between Tracker and RLStats)

howTo.title: How to configure Parse.bot
howTo.step1: 1. Create an account at parse.bot (free plan: 200 credits, no card required).
howTo.step2: 2. Create a new scraper pointing at rlstats.net or tracker.network with the task "get player MMR by platform and identifier".
howTo.step3: 3. Copy the Scraper ID and endpoint name from the parse.bot dashboard.
howTo.step4: 4. Generate an API key in Settings > API Keys and paste it here.
howTo.note: Each user uses their own account and credits. The app sends platform and identifier to the scraper.
